862-3967-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crimson Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
862-3967-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crimson Kobolds spell. Then, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4359-5078-5243-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2060-4687-6006.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least four counters on it.
2060-4687-6006.description:
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Crystalline Crawler, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

3055-3175-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

4613-5446-7150-7804.notablePrerequisites:
You control two additional creatures, one of which must have a +1/+1 counter on it and hasn't used Kirol's ability this turn.
The top card of your library is a nonland card.
4613-5446-7150-7804.description:
Cast Esika's Chariot by paying {3}{G}.
When Esika's Chariot enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Kirol's ability by tapping two creatures you control, copying Esika's Chariot's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Esika's Chariot's trigger, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
When the Cats enter, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers twice, revealing the top card of your library, putting it back on top and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Cat.
Repeat from step 3, using one of the Cats to activate Kirol's ability, and then tapping both Cats.

215-1129-4359.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
215-1129-4359.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1558-4840-7631.description:
Cast Echocasting Symposium by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere and exiling Echocasting Symposium.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Myr Battlesphere token and the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1322-3259-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
1322-3259-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

204-1858-2056-2633-4460.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1858-2056-2633-4460.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

2440-6791-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-6791-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

1545-3490-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-3490-5231-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2173-2459-5220-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3799-6899.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Stuffy Doll if it has summoning sickness.
3799-6899.description:
Deal damage to Stuffy Doll, either using its ability or another method.
Stuffy Doll triggers, attempting to deal damage to you, but dealing damage to Stuffy Doll instead due to With Great Power....
Repeat step 2 in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw.

2060-2576-2919-3525.description:
Activate Temple Elder by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's ability by paying {U}, untapping Temple Elder.
Repeat.

2178-5173-6095-6797.easyPrerequisites:
Zul Ashur, Lich Lord does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zul Ashur.
2178-5173-6095-6797.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting Shambling Ghast.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambing Ghast dies, it and Zul Ashur trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zul Ashur trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4871-6291-6716.description:
Activate Glimmer Bairn by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Glimmer Bairn ability.
Repeat.

1636-2511-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
1636-2511-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
Repeat.

67-997-2781.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reveillark.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

700-1339-2498-4050-6739.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two cards in hand.
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 3.
700-1339-2498-4050-6739.description:
Activate Reckless Assault by paying {1} and 2 life, dealing 1 damage to Body of Knowledge.
Body of Knowledge triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Sheoldred and The Locust God trigger.
Resolve the Sheoldred trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5226-5531-6621-6664.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5226-5531-6621-6664.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.

3358-4881-6633.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-4120-4772.easyPrerequisites: Walking Ballista has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3693-4120-4772.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
3693-4120-4772.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

2034-2043-2557-5446.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating eight 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
2034-2043-2557-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) with Urza's ability.

2382-4050-5659--33.notablePrerequisites: One Lhurgoyf must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mimic Vat.
2382-4050-5659--33.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a nontoken Lhurgoyf, adding one mana of any color.
When the Lhurgoyf dies, Mimic Vat triggers, exiling the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard and returning the Lhurgoyf that was exiled to your graveyard.
Disa's first ability triggers, putting the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

396-4050-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it, Blessed Sanctuary and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Cat and Unicorn, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1636-2857-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
1636-2857-5256.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

2051-2546-2657-4566.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
2051-2546-2657-4566.description:
Activate Barren Moor's cycling ability by paying {B} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Barren Moor ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ayula's Influence by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Ayula's Influence ability, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Barren Moor and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

771-1760.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
771-1760.description:
Cast Surge to Victory by paying {4}{R}{R}, exiling Savage Beating from your graveyard and giving creatures you control +5/+0 until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with any creature you control.
Surge to Victory triggers, casting a copy of Savage Beating without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Savage Beating, untapping all creatures you control and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

308-1580-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites: You attacked with a creature this turn.
308-1580-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
Reassembling Skeleton dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Reassembling Skeleton's power.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {B}, returning it to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

614-1518-1987-3573.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.You control at least two artifacts.
614-1518-1987-3573.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

650-3175-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
